# GnomeTrotting

> > A travel and expat guide featuring destination tips, hiking adventures, and pet-friendly travel advice from a globe-trotting gnome named Honks.

GnomeTrotting is a travel blog documenting six years of global exploration across Europe, Asia, and North America, with a focus on practical guides for specific destinations and pet-friendly travel experiences. The site combines personal travel narratives with actionable advice for expats and adventurous travelers.

## Core Pages

- [About the Gnome | GnomeTrotting](https://www.gnometrotting.com/about-the-gnome): About page featuring Honks the gnome and the author's six-year travel journey.

## Travel Guides & Destination Comparisons

- [Visiting Budapest in 2025 vs. 2014 | GnomeTrotting](https://www.gnometrotting.com/visiting-budapest-in-2025-vs-2014): Travel article comparing Budapest's changes across 11 years, thermal baths and ruin bars.
- [Is Budapest Dog-Friendly? | GnomeTrotting](https://www.gnometrotting.com/is-budapest-dog-friendly): Guide to dog-friendly activities and attractions in Budapest for pet travelers.
- [Inca Trail diary | GnomeTrotting](https://www.gnometrotting.com/inca-trail-diary): Hiking guide and diary for the 4-day Inca Trail trek to Machu Picchu, Peru.
- [What to know about driving in Milan | GnomeTrotting](https://www.gnometrotting.com/what-know-driving-milan): Practical guide to driving in Milan covering ZTL zones and parking rules.
- [Visiting Milan with a dog | GnomeTrotting](https://www.gnometrotting.com/visiting-milan-with-dog): Guide to dog-friendly sightseeing in Milan including parks and pet-accessible sites.
- [Is it better to stay in Locarno or Ascona? | GnomeTrotting](https://www.gnometrotting.com/better-to-stay-locarno-ascona): Comparison guide for Lake Maggiore towns Locarno and Ascona, Switzerland.
